description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template method for setting context fields within a web application, specifically for the Apache OFBiz framework. It defines a method to add key-value pairs to a request context map.

classes.name: SetContextFieldTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker method class for setting a context field in the request environment.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method to set a context variable with a specified name and value, validating arguments and updating the request context map.
